identity.slogan_en: Evidence moves south. Corrections return north.

logo_concept.zh: 抽象J/Z铁路折线与相反方向箭头，表达证据南行、纠错北返和到期切换。
logo_concept.en: An abstract J/Z railway switchback with opposing arrows for evidence southbound, correction northbound and expiry switching.
logo_concept.rights_note: Proposal-created identity only; no institutional or third-party mark is used.

pilgrimage_landmarks.public_function: display each test question, version, owner and entry condition
record human and agent contribution, dispute and revision side by side
make limits, expiry and shutdown visible instead of advertising success
track whether a correction reached every affected physical and digital channel

cultural_system.narrative_zh: 从工程日志到开源日志：测量、交接、检修的公共工程纪律，延伸为版本、贡献、失败与恢复记录。
cultural_system.narrative_en: From engineering log to open-source log: extend measurement, handover and repair into records of version, contribution, failure and recovery.

annual_programs.deliverable: licensed data notes, failure samples and multi-metric challenge reports
same-channel recovery cases submitted by residents and frontline staff
contribution logs, archive translation and screenless heritage routes

annual_programs.name_zh: 年度权利审计与国际交换
annual_programs.name_en: Annual Rights Audit and International Exchange
annual_programs.deliverable: public register of paused, modified and retired projects with transfer-boundary review

conversion_pathways.developer: bounded task -> test -> engineering handover -> revision or retirement
conversion_pathways.enterprise: open day -> problem diagnosis -> PoC -> procurement dossier -> risk clinic
conversion_pathways.public: heritage visit -> screenless experience -> media literacy -> correction intake
conversion_pathways.international: bilingual case library -> bounded replication -> joint report

authority_limits: All interfaces, events and landmarks are proposal concepts, not confirmed partnerships or commitments.
Location, structure, fire safety, lighting, heritage impact, data permission and operating resources require formal review.
Core public screenless service remains free; event footfall cannot substitute for correction outcomes.
